 PREVIEW: ELCHE CF VS. VALENCIA CF
 Valencia CF play Elche CF at the Martínez Valero this Sunday
 LaLiga Matchday 11 
 Valencia CF's eleventh match of the LaLiga season comes following the postponement of their Copa del Rey fixture against UE Tavernes in midweek, and a defeat to Villarreal CF at Mestalla on Matchday 10. The team travel the short distance to Elche aiming to return to winning ways and take a second victory of the season.
 Elche CF head into this match following a win against Pinatar in the Copa del Rey, advancing to the second round of the competition. They also took victory over Rayo Vallecano at Vallecas in their most recent LALIGA fixture. Martín Anselmi’s side currently sit in sixteenth place in the standings, with 10 points from ten games played.
 Javier Aguirre: "A win would reinforce the work we do every day" 
 Follow the game live through our App, club website and official Valencia CF Youtube channel.  
 Kickoff:  6:30pm local time 
 Venue:  Martínez Valero
 Referee:  Luis Bestard 
 VAR:  Daniel Jesús Trujillo
